description: Convx 1.5.3 Official Release delivers a rock-solid audio & player experience, built-in free lyrics translation, offline Greek romanization, intelligent lyrics fallback with duration accuracy, and critical playback resilience.

changelog.title: Lyrics & Translation Engine
items: Integrated built-in free Google Translate engine: lyrics can now be translated out-of-the-box without requiring AI API keys or third-party configurations.
Implemented resilient provider fallback with duration accuracy validation: LRCLIB duration mismatches gracefully fallback to official YouTube Music lyrics.
Added persistent Room database caching for translations and intelligent not-found state management to prevent continuous looping or data waste.
Added offline Greek (ELOT 743 / ISO 843) lyric romanization with a dedicated toggle switch in Romanization Settings.
Made the lyrics translation toggle universally available and interactive directly within the player transport row and lyrics menu.

changelog.title: Player & Audio Engine Stability
items: Zero-latency StateFlow architecture in PlayerConnection eliminates state flickering and empty lyrics during transitions between Home and Lyrics player.
Smooth DSP volume normalization: neutral gain holding prevents abrupt volume jumps when format metadata resolves.
Resolved audio stall and false-positive recovery triggers during intro silence and network handoffs.
Cleaned up transport control hierarchy and resolved Classic Player album cover rendering across all background styles.

changelog.title: Database & Lifecycle Resilience
items: Fixed Room database cleanup query to safeguard YouTube Music, YouTube Subtitle, and Manual user lyrics across service restarts.
Resolved activity service binding lifecycle leak to ensure seamless resume from background.

changelog.title: UI & Landscape Ergonomics
items: Eliminated Liquid Glass shader seam cut and visual artifacts when dialing reflection height to maximum values.
Added vertical scrolling support to Sleep Timer and Bluetooth Audio Device sheets, preventing UI cutoff in horizontal/landscape view.
